name: Design System & Styling
description: Global CSS and Tailwind theme configuration including color palette (dark, cream, purple, pink), typography, keyframe animations (float-slow, float-slower, gradient-shift, fade-in-up, glow-pulse, shimmer), and design tokens

name: Utilities & Helpers
description: Reusable utility functions and helper modules used by components and pages

name: Reusable Components
description: Presentational React components that are composed into pages and content sections. Includes interactive elements (CodeBlock with copy-to-clipboard), callout boxes (ProTip), step indicators (StepCard), and footer (TianaSessionFooter)

name: Pages & Content
description: Top-level pages and content modules. Layout.tsx provides the root HTML structure with metadata and animated background decorations. Page.tsx is the home page entry point. tiana-ai-positioning-workshop.tsx contains the main workshop content with multiple sections, prompt cards, and step-by-step exercises
